sources.title: DistilBERT in Natural Language Processing - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a lightweight version of BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) developed by Hugging Face using knowledge distillation. It retains most of BERT's language understanding capabilities while reducing model size, memory usage, and computational requirements, making it suitable for resource-constrained devices and real-time NLP applications. sources.title: Beijing Strikes Back At Washington's AI Distillation Accusation
sources.snippet: China's Ministry of Commerce on Monday struck back against Washington's recent accusations that Chinese AI firms are stealing U.S. intellectual property by distilling American AI models, saying the claim has no factual basis or legal support.
